description: This file defines a command handler class for activating a group center, specifically implementing the processing logic to activate a group or center within the Fineract system.

classes.name: ActivateCenterCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles activation commands for group centers, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: ActivateCenterCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the activation command by delegating to the writePlatformService to activate the group or center.
